claims.claim: A 2008 Cell study outlined how declining NAD+ reduces sirtuin activity, which alters histone modifications and erodes epigenetic stability.
claims.episode_span: A 2008 study outlined how declining NAD+ reduces sirtuin activity, which alters histone modifications and erodes epigenetic stability, leading to loss of cellular identity.
claims.source_title: Information theory of aging: NAD+ to sirtuins to epigenetic stability
claims.supporting_quote: So true - the Information theory of aging in 2008: NAD+ ➡️ sirtuins ➡️ histone modification ➡️ epigenetic stability ➡️ cellular identity ➡️ slower aging

claims.claim: Researchers identified a substance produced by muscle tissue when worms experience lower temperatures that slowed multiple aging markers.
claims.episode_span: Researchers identified a substance produced by muscle tissue when worms experience lower temperatures. This factor slowed multiple aging markers in the model organism.
claims.source_title: Cold-Responsive Muscle Substance Delays Aging in Worms
claims.supporting_quote: Cold-Responsive Muscle Substance Delays Aging in Worms

claims.claim: Scientists at Ruhr University Bochum engineered light-sensitive proteins that suppress activity in targeted neurons and cardiac muscle cells.
claims.episode_span: Scientists at Ruhr University Bochum and partner institutions engineered light-sensitive proteins that suppress activity in targeted cells. The tools were tested in neurons and cardiac muscle cells.
claims.source_title: New optogenetic tool inhibits activity in neurons and heart muscle cells
claims.supporting_quote: Researchers from Ruhr University Bochum have partnered with colleagues in Göttingen, Berlin, Paris and Essen to develop new optogenetic tools that can selectively inhibit cellular activity through light.

claims.claim: University of Cambridge analysis found that exam board materials for secondary science courses contain almost no references to female researchers.
claims.episode_span: University of Cambridge analysis found that exam board materials for secondary science courses contain almost no references to female researchers.
claims.source_title: UK science exam specifications omit women scientists and may widen gender gap
claims.supporting_quote: An absence of women scientists in U.K. exam board specifications for science could be a factor in the disproportionate number of girls dropping STEM subjects at 16

claims.claim: University of Würzburg researchers compiled findings from roughly 180 studies on Candida auris.
claims.episode_span: University of Würzburg researchers compiled findings from roughly 180 studies on Candida auris.
claims.source_title: Candida auris: A harbinger of further dangerous fungal species?
claims.supporting_quote: Carla Schuh and Chaitanya Gokhale from the Biocentre at the University of Würzburg have now summarized the current state of knowledge in a review article in the journal mSphere. To that end, they analyzed around 180 studies by other researchers.

claims.claim: Vilnius University researchers built perovskite-based lasers that showed no measurable degradation after more than 400 million pulses.
claims.episode_span: Vilnius University researchers built perovskite-based lasers that showed no measurable degradation after extended operation.
claims.source_title: Perovskite laser maintains stable performance over 400 million pulses
claims.supporting_quote: In a study published in Advanced Optical Materials, researchers at Vilnius University (VU) demonstrated perovskite-based laser structures that maintained stable performance over more than 400 million pulses.

claims.claim: An insect-borne virus that causes high mortality in white-tailed deer and mimics foot-and-mouth disease in cattle has stayed uncommon in New York state.
claims.episode_span: An insect-borne virus that causes high mortality in white-tailed deer and mimics foot-and-mouth disease in cattle has stayed uncommon in New York state.
claims.supporting_quote: is still rare in New York state, but the warming climate may increase its future spread

claims.claim: A McGill University study tracked how residents responded to Environment and Climate Change Canada advisories during intense smoke events.
claims.episode_span: A McGill University study tracked how residents responded to Environment and Climate Change Canada advisories during intense smoke events.
claims.supporting_quote: according to a new McGill University study published in Health & Place

claims.claim: A big-eyed, venomous primate absent from scientific records since the 1930s was found living in gardens, roadsides, and power lines on Bangka island.
claims.episode_span: A big-eyed, venomous primate absent from scientific records since the 1930s was found living in gardens, roadsides, and power lines on Bangka island.
